title: File of grants
description: The input of the option --grants of the tool access-lint. It holds the grants of one subject, as a list. Each grant has the shape of a grant in fake-pdp-data. The schema is closed. A schema cannot check a grant against the action document, but access-lint does.

grants.description: The grants of one subject. A grant gives an action on a node, with limit values (protocol 3.5, 6.1). The grant of the action access on the service gives the budgets (protocol 8.3).
